_comment: Golden eval set for v2 retrieval + answer quality. relevant_ids are CHUNK-level, keyed meetingId#seq (stable across re-ingest, unlike bigserial ids) — the chunks that actually contain the answer; retrievalEval.ts scores chunk-level recall@k/MRR/nDCG against them. relevant_meetings stays for meeting-level / agent scoring. Each question maps to a query type from PLAN.md. q8+ target the long generated meetings; q16-q19 are adversarial (entity confusion, revised decision, cross-meeting no-conflation, tempting refusal).

questions.question: What did Sarah raise as a concern about the login endpoint?
What are all the open action items and who owns each?
expected_facts: Sam: set up CI pipeline (next sprint)
Jordan: update the auth design doc

questions.question: What is our current decision on where to store refresh tokens?
questions.notes: Tests recency/superseded handling: the eng-sync decision supersedes the implicit localStorage assumption; arch-review (2026-06-17) restates it as final and is the most recent.

questions.question: What did we decide for the main database, and why?
How did our authentication approach evolve over the two meetings?
expected_facts: moved refresh tokens to httpOnly cookies after a security review

questions.question: Who chose Deepgram for transcription and what was the reasoning?
What did we decide about the mobile app redesign?
expected_facts: not found / not discussed in any meeting

questions.question: What rate limit did the team put on the login endpoint, and why?
questions.notes: Fact lives in the transcript, NOT as a structured decision row (D5) — tests that hybrid transcript search surfaces non-pre-structured detail. Sales-call chunks are distractors.

questions.question: What did the team decide about speaker diarization?
expected_facts: defer it to a v4 batch job
batch is cheaper than running it live

questions.question: Where and how will Raven be deployed to start?
What transcription tool does Acme use today, and why are they unhappy with it?
expected_facts: only gives raw transcripts with no decisions or action items
questions.notes: Sales meeting; engineering arch-review chunks are distractors.

questions.question: What pilot did Acme agree to?
What are Acme's main concerns or blockers about adopting Raven?
questions.notes: Type-specific (sales objections) answered at query time from the transcript, not from a pre-structured objections table (D5).

questions.question: What are the action items from the Acme sales call and who owns each?
expected_facts: Dana: set up the pilot workspace (Monday)

questions.question: What did the team decide for the primary database and the vector store, and why?
expected_facts: pgvector instead of a separate vector database

questions.question: What budget did Priya from Northwind say they had for tooling?
questions.notes: Adversarial — entity confusion. Acme (sales-acme) has a ~$30k budget; the agent must scope to Northwind and not return Acme's number.

questions.question: What days did the team settle on for deploys?
questions.notes: Adversarial — revised decision. Friday deploys were proposed then explicitly scratched ('Scratch that'); the agent must report the FINAL decision, not the rejected one.

questions.question: Across the sales calls, what budget did each prospect mention?
expected_facts: Northwind: about twenty to twenty-five thousand
Acme: about thirty thousand a year
questions.notes: Adversarial — cross-meeting aggregation over two SIMILAR meetings; the agent must keep each budget attributed to the right prospect (no conflation).

questions.question: What did the team decide about offering a free tier?
expected_facts: not found / not discussed in any meeting
questions.notes: Adversarial — tempting refusal. Pricing IS discussed (per-seat, budgets), but a free tier is never mentioned; the agent must refuse rather than confabulate from adjacent pricing talk.
